subject: Offer path and seniority evidence for Caroline Nguyen
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seniority evidence needed — Caroline (final onsite)

Folks,

Caroline's onsite loop wrapped yesterday. Feedback skews high on system design and influence, but mixed on direct people management experience. Hiring team is split between L6 Principal IC and L6 Manager. Compensation ask sits near our L6 midpoint.

Hiring manager (Ethan Park) wants to move quickly; candidate has two other live processes. Before I sign off on an offer, I need:
- Clear decision on title (Principal IC vs Manager) and rationale we can present to the candidate.
- Any precedent where we offered L6 Manager to a largely IC-focused profile (if so, outcome).
- Confirmation on comp target band and whether we can stretch equity for retention.

Attachments: candidate CV and latest comp band extract.

Can you review and reply with your recommendation today?

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Dir, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--- Message 2 ---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seniority evidence needed — Caroline (final onsite)

Thanks Laura — quick read through the notes and CV. My take:

Summary: strong individual contributor with clear cross-functional leadership and technical ownership; limited direct people management (no more than 2 ICs historically). The role on the hiring doc is "Manager, Inference Platform" but we can flex to Principal if we want to be conservative on title while still giving manager-level scope.

Recommendation:
- Offer L6 Principal (IC) with an explicit career path to Manager within 9-12 months contingent on leading one team hire and shipping a measurable infra metric (latency or cost improvement).
- Base at L6 midpoint, 10% sign-on, RSU grant at 1.1x of standard L6 (to reflect market).
- Include a 6-month check-in with ability to convert to Manager title and bump comp if manager responsibilities are assumed.

Rationale: preserves hiring bar (we don't mis-title), gives candidate a clear path to managerial scope, and provides us the leverage to measure before committing permanent manager title. Also avoids inflating manager headcount now.

If there are objections, please flag now — I can present this to the candidate.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 ---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-01T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seniority evidence needed — Caroline (final onsite)

Agree with Markus but a few notes from comp/benchmarks:
- Market shows similar profiles getting manager title ~30% of the time at competitive offers; most companies are explicit about "IC-first, transition to manager" language.
- Stretch RSU at 1.1x is acceptable given headroom in the L6 band, but base should not exceed midpoint + 7% unless we have exec approval.
- If we convert to Manager during the 6-12 month window we should have a predefined comp adjustment (base + 12%, equity refresh at manager band). Put that in the offer terms to set expectations.

I'll update the comp worksheet and put a redline for the conversion clause.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Dir, Total Compensation
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Nguyen <caroline@greentech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Offer from Redwood Inference — Engineering (Inference Platform)

Caroline —

Thanks again for spending time with our team. We were impressed by your systems design thinking and cross-team leadership. We'd love to extend a formal offer for the Engineering role on the Inference Platform. Below are the high-level terms we can commit to now — an official offer packet will follow from LA HR with detailed numbers.

Role & Title: L6 Principal Engineer (Individual Contributor)
Reporting: Ethan Park, Head of Inference Platform
Base: $210,000 (L6 midpoint)
Sign-on: $21,000 (10%, paid pro-rata over first 6 months)
Equity: RSU grant at 1.1x of standard L6 allocation (4-year vest; 1-year cliff)
Start: Target Nov 8, flexible by two weeks
Conversion Path: We will include an explicit conversion-to-manager clause — if within 9-12 months you demonstrate leading a hiring + a deliverable that improves key infra metric, we will convert title to Manager (L6 manager band) and adjust comp per the conversion formula in your offer.

We're trying to strike a balance: recognize your impact today while keeping an accountable path to managerial responsibilities. Please let me know if you have urgent questions — Rebecca from your recruiter will coordinate the formal packet.

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 5 ---
From: Caroline Nguyen <caroline@greentech.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood Inference — Engineering (Inference Platform)

Hi Markus —

Thank you — I appreciate the clarity on the pathway and the equity flexibility. Two quick questions before I sign: 
1) The conversion clause sounds reasonable — can I get the exact metric threshold (e.g., % latency reduction or cost-per-token target) so I can evaluate?
2) Would Redwood consider a 12-month pro-rated sign-on (rather than 6-month) to help with my counteroffer timeline?

I’m excited about the role and the team — happy to sign once we align on those two points.

Warmly,
Caroline Nguyen
Senior Staff Engineer (current)
Greentech Energy
